title: Knowledge Fork — Evidence, Discernment, Responsibility, Life and Strife
purpose: Deepen Tree of Knowledge as the upstream decision point where information can become orientation/repair or exposure/capture/Strife.
epistemic_rule: Knowledge does not carry moral valence by itself. Evaluate source quality, interpretation, purpose, audience, incentives and downstream consequence.
discernment_questions: What exactly is known versus inferred?
Who is affected if the claim is wrong?
Why is this information being surfaced now?
What action does it invite or enable?
Does publication preserve agency, privacy, proportionality and correction?
What Fruit/Strife could this knowledge grow?
withholding_branch: temporary non-publication can be responsible when privacy, safety, uncertainty or due process outweigh immediate exposure
eye_relation: Eye perceives/evaluates; Knowledge Fork decides how interpreted information is routed into action.
door_relation: Some knowledge opens a Door by changing perceived affordances/capability; not every discovery should trigger immediate crossing.
shadow_relation: Excluded counterevidence or unexamined assumptions can create model-shadow; discernment must actively search for what the current frame omits.
archive_relation: Preserve provenance and correction even when public visibility is reduced.
